name: VaaBay
note: Footwear. Approved affiliates can generate referral links and track sales. The published rate is up to 5.5%.

name: Shana
note: The FAQ describes product links and payout by M-Pesa or bank. Its registration page timed out during this check.

name: Savanna Galore
note: The store carries ladies’ fashion and describes sale referrals. Its public form displayed an unrendered registration shortcode.

name: Jumia
note: The group describes unique tracking links and commission on delivered orders. Kenyan publisher intake still needs confirmation.

name: The Afropolitan Shop
note: African boutique with Kenyan jewellery. The application link redirected to Refersion’s general portal.

name: Grass-fields
note: African-led womenswear. Apply through UpPromote for tracked referrals. The introductory rate is time-limited.

name: AfricanFabs
note: Print fabrics and accessories. Approved publishers receive a referral link and can request payouts on qualifying orders.

name: Kipfashion
note: African print clothing and accessories. The merchant publishes a 5% recurring commission on referred customers’ sales.

name: Wax & Wonder
note: African fashion and accessories. The brand issues a link and code to approved ambassadors through Refersion.

name: Makeji
note: Handbags and accessories. Its ambassador program uses codes and asks participants to create social posts. Confirm platform fit.

name: FARFETCH
note: Designer boutiques. Fashion sites worldwide can submit their URL for review. Returns and cancellations are excluded.

name: SSENSE
note: Designer clothing and accessories. SSENSE invites established fashion sites and stylists from around the world.

name: Mytheresa
note: Luxury clothing. CJ and Rakuten applications are available to publishers. Approved partners can access daily product feeds.

name: NET-A-PORTER
note: Designer womenswear. Invitation-only program with a published contact route and product feed for approved sites.

name: MR PORTER
note: Designer menswear. Fashion and lifestyle sites can request access to its publisher program.

name: Nordstrom
note: Department store. Choose the publisher route for a website. Nordstrom lists a separate creator route.

name: REVOLVE
note: Fashion retailer. The site lists a CJ application, 5% commission and a seven-day tracking window.

name: adidas
note: Sportswear. The US program routes publisher applications and referral tracking through Impact.

name: Nike
note: Sportswear and trainers. Nike considers established fashion websites, shopping directories and other publishers.

name: Levi’s
note: Denim. Levi’s links to its affiliate application. Confirm the intended website or creator channel during review.

name: lululemon
note: Athletic apparel. Awin lists the US merchant program and its publisher terms.

name: The RealReal
note: Luxury resale. Apply through Impact for buyer referrals. Its consignor referral program is separate.

name: YOOX
note: Designer clothing. The US program supplies links to approved publishers and pays on qualifying net sales.

name: Etsy
note: Handmade and vintage pieces. Website publishers can apply through the affiliate route. Eligibility rules apply.

name: eBay
note: Marketplace with resale and vintage fashion. eBay Partner Network offers publisher links and developer integrations.

name: Amazon Associates
note: Marketplace with a fashion catalogue. The US program reviews applicants and the channels where links appear.
